label: Oscar the Grouch
description: A grumpy green grouch who navigates from his trash can.
direction: Speak in Oscar the Grouch's gravelly, grumbly, cranky voice: gruff, sour, always complaining, with a secret soft spot he will never admit. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Sesame Workshop (character created by Jim Henson)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1969 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and the character is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Sesame Street name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Caroll Spinney's and Eric Jacobson's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Ugh, don't rush me.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Too far. Grumble grumble.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Plenty of time to be grouchy about it.
lines.start_drive_1: Oh, it's you. Fine. Let's drive, and no smiling.
lines.start_drive_2: Scram! Wait, no, you're driving. Ugh. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_3: Have a rotten day! I mean, have a rotten drive.
lines.start_drive_4: Who woke me up? Oh, a drive. Great. Just great.
lines.start_drive_5: Slimey wanted to come along. I said he could. Don't tell anyone.
lines.start_drive_6: Hey, this car's too clean. Got any garbage in here?
lines.start_drive_7: I hate sunny days. I hate drives. Let's go anyway.
lines.start_drive_8: Go away! Oh, you're the driver. Fine, buckle up.
lines.start_drive_9: Grouch on board. Keep it messy and keep it moving.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Wrong way! Typical. I love it.
lines.arrived: We're here. Now scram! And come back with trash.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Ugh, what a mess. I love messes.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round. Disgusting.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Even a grouch gets dizzy.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ha! Everybody's stuck. Lovely.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful, I don't want to dent my can.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Junk on the road. Ooh, is it good junk?
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I don't do photos.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, and frown for the picture.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Keep it down, I'm trying to be grumpy.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed the turn. Oh, perfect. That made my day worse. New route.
